name: Widget Preflight (HUD / Pause / Notification)
description: Preflight pass over the in-game widget catalog: HUD digits, pause-menu rows, save/load notifications. Combines a deterministic preflight call with a manual visual sanity step inside the SGFX shell. The shell's QA panel surfaces the workflow id so the operator can attest from inside the running runtime.
dod_items: HUD digit widgets render correctly under the SGFX text overrides
Pause menu rows survive the title-text scoped rules
Notification widgets (save complete, achievement unlock) render readable text
Widget atlas dimensions match retail (no override that resizes a CSD atlas)

checks.description: Run the standard preflight pack against the selected profile. Acts as the deterministic gate: anchors / constants / carpaints / project_sanity must all pass before the manual widget pass starts.

prompts: HUD digits OK in title shell?
checks.description: Eyes-on the SGFX shell title + a stage stub. The runner emits a single attestation record; partial completion maps to in_progress.
